functionalParity.optionalFieldReason: radard does not consume RadarPoint aRel or yvRel; acceleration is estimated from the tracked lead velocity
functionalParity.objectBank: bus 1, 0x180-0x184, 32 bytes, two 128-bit slots per message, ten objects total

decodedFields.relativeVelocity: s11 at bit 91, scale 0.05 m/s, offset 2.4 m/s
decodedFields.rollingCounter: u4 at bit 124; all values 0 through 15 are valid

controlBehavior.normalSpeed: camera/model lead association remains mandatory and first
controlBehavior.velocityFusion: decoded radar velocity contributes only after maturity and close model consensus, with bounded blend weight and model fallback on disagreement
controlBehavior.radarOnlyCreation: limited to low speed with persistence, model-path, lateral, distance, lead-speed, and observed-distance-rate gates

defectsFixed: Counter value zero was misclassified as invalid, freezing about 8.2 percent of continuous object updates.
A 0.80 m stationary sub-bumper return could briefly qualify as a radar-only lead.
The old layout validator compared different raw object IDs and produced a misleading failure.
Recycled or conflicting raw IDs could inherit stale track maturity before the identity reset fix.
boundary: This is complete openpilot radar parsing and fusion parity for the observed R0100 object stream. It does not allow raw radar to independently command highway braking; established openpilot radar integrations also fuse radar with model lead selection.
